en.hubeali: From him, from Usman, from Sama’at who said,
‘I asked about the dog, ‘Can we keep it in the house?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No’.
en.sarwar: 3. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from ‘Uthman from Sama‘ah who has said the following: “
I once asked him (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, if we can keep a dog in the house. He (the Imam) said, ‘No, you must not do so.’”
